verdict.rationale: The docs show you can create and manage API keys (key ID plus secret, used via HTTP Basic Auth), so an agent could be given its own revocable credential. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped to particular endpoints, accounts, or permissions, which is the core of the least-privilege story. Missing for 10: per-key scopes or permissions, read-only or endpoint-restricted keys, account-level restrictions, key expiry or rotation docs, independent corroboration.
